review_method: Opened and visually inspected all six final PNG figures, including both language editions.
observations: Axes, numerical labels, Chinese glyphs, legends and planned Gantt roles were visible without observed clipping. Feedback figures identify mock data; timeline identifies proposed work. Plots read saved results.
scope: Visual layout and saved-data consistency, not independent peer review or chemical validation. Manuscript checks separately cover bilingual numerical parity, full combined-edition content, sections and links.
